what: The card catalog of the library (Alexandria): every work, one row each, with where to read it.
how: Each row follows "columns". site is a number into "sites". A work is read at sites[site].live + live (an empty live is the site's front page); when live is null the work is not on a live site yet, so read its source. The source of every work is sites[site].source + path. also lists other sites that publish the same page, at sites[n].live + live. class and also_class are keys of "classes" (Dewey numbers); place is a key of "places", and place_by says how the place was decided. organ is soul (the science) or heart (the hardware and the Lansing Scuffle) or empty. For people the same catalog is the page at "page"; a place on the globe is at places[place].atlas.
